notes.title: Massive Content Update!
notes.content:
Adrift - Massive Content Update
I am thrilled to announce the release of a massive content update for Adrift! After months of development, this update brings many new features, enhancements, and surprises. Below is an overview of the key additions, but I'll leave some things for you to discover on your own!

Overview of the Update
Infinite Progression: A brand-new prestige system allows endless progression.
New Currency System: A unit-based currency that scales indefinitely.
Cabin Expansions: Unlock new cabin expansions as you progress through prestige levels.
New Boats: Unlock unique boats with each prestige level.
Customization: Unlock new clothing options for your character.
Plant Growing: Cultivate plants in a greenhouse.
New Universe Types: Discover new universes based on prestige level.
Expanded Item Catalog: New items available for purchase.
The Depths: A brand-new game section featuring submarine exploration.
Fish Tank Feature: Catch and collect cosmic fish.
Cabin Naming: Name your cabin for a personal touch.
Fishing Enhancements: Activate an easy mode for fishing.
Enhanced Interactions: More interactions added to existing items.
Visual Upgrades: Improved textures, lighting, and visual effects.
New Steam Achievements: Added achievements to challenge and reward players.






Prestige System
Players can now prestige at the Golden Tree in the Painting World.
Unlock up to four major cabin expansions, each bringing new features:
First Expansion: Unlocks new purchasable items.
Second Expansion: Grants access to The Depths and additional items.
Third Expansion: Unlocks clothing options and new items.
Fourth Expansion: Introduces the Greenhouse, where players can grow plants.
Each prestige grants a new boat.
Each prestige multiplies the money you make.
The first four prestige levels introduce new universe tiers.
Planet Generator will get faster each time the player prestiges.
Prestige Progress Tracking: A sign next to your cabin displays your prestige level.
Endless Progression: After reaching Prestige 25, players can continue progressing for higher profits even though they won't earn any more rewards.

The Depths
A completely new gameplay section that allows players to explore the vast space between universes using a submarine:
Freely explore a dynamically generated underwater cosmos.
Harvest universes for stardust.
Catch cosmic fish and display them in your cabin’s fish tank.
Encounter massive creatures while exploring.





New Items
Over 200 new items have been added, including:
Cabin decorations
Hats and clothing
Plants
Many older items now feature new interactions.

New Universes
Introduces four new universe tiers unlocked via prestige:
S Tier
S+ Tier
S++ Tier
S+++ Tier
22 new universes added, expanding the total count to 37.
Newly unlocked universes are integrated into the random pool encountered when sailing.

New Boats
25 brand-new boats to unlock.
A new boat is granted every prestige level.
Each boat features unique designs and different planet storage methods.

notes.title: Massive Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[b]Massive content update coming soon![/b]
Thank you to everyone who has supported and played Adrift! I am currently working on a massive content update that I plan to release in the next few months. Adrift will be put on sale when this update is released.

[b]Update Plans[/b]
1. Infinite progression (Allows players to prestige for rewards and ability to earn more money)
2. Cabin expansion (Allows players to expand cabin with new areas and items)
3. New universes (more universes to discover based on the player's prestige level
4. New boats (Allows players to unlock new boats)
5. Depths exploration (Upon a specified prestige level the player will be able to explore the depths in a submarine and harvest universes for stardust. There may also be some creatures to catch...)

There are plenty of other quality of life changes and secrets I will be adding. I look forward to releasing this content update and thank you all again for your support.
